开始之前，你需要先申请一个ChatGPT API KEY（SK），也就是与ChatGPT通信的Authorization Token。

API Key查看地址： `https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys`

账户页面 `https://platform.openai.com/api-keys`

登录页面 `https://platform.openai.com/` `https://platform.openai.com/signup`

##### [](#openai密钥)OpenAI密钥

```
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
```

##### [](#curl代码)curl代码

```
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer 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" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "store": true,
    "messages": [
      {"role": "user", "content": "write a haiku about ai"}
    ]
  }'
```

##### [](#替换openai账号apiaihao123cn)替换OpenAI账号(`api.aihao123.cn`)

请求接口时将`https://api.openai.com` 改为我们的API地址 `https://api.aihao123.cn/luomacode-api/open-api` 即可调用

账号信息

```
var openaiApiKey = "sk-1qnrs1ni7325t6ihjest9cjqqvljht7pbsgjp6nifc2mdbgo";
var endpoint = new Uri("https://api.aihao123.cn/luomacode-api/open-api");
```
